sloka: यस्मिन् हरि हयः श्रीमान् महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः ।अभिषिक्तः सुरै राजा मेघो नाम स पर्वतः ॥४-४२-३५॥
transliteration: yasmin hari hayaḥ śrīmān mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ।abhiṣiktaḥ surai rājā megho nāma sa parvataḥ ॥4-42-35॥

translations.english: 'Possessor of tawny horses, king Indra who killed demon Pakasasana was consecrated by gods at this mountain since known as Meghavan.
